KeysToEntries.ID_TRINKET_ELEPHANTOBELISK_DESC: An object of particular nomadic fixation, some believe that these legendary beasts of burden carried the Launch Towers into place.
KeysToEntries.ID_TRINKET_EQUATORIALSUNDAL_DESC: A marvel of ancient ingenuity, those with a penchant for stargazing may find the mesmerizing patterns oddly familiar.
KeysToEntries.ID_TRINKET_FOOTBALLERSHOES_DESC: This specialized footwear is adorned with vibrant ceremonial designs, and designed to anchor the wearer to the ground. It is thought to have belonged to ancient wanderers of great renown.
KeysToEntries.ID_TRINKET_SEXTANT_DESC: Once thought to be a rudimentary spaceship prototype, it is claimed by the Nomads to be a sophisticated method for documenting one’s travels.
KeysToEntries.ID_TRINKET_TELLURION_DESC: A marvel of ancient ingenuity, those with a penchant for stargazing may find the mesmerizing patterns oddly familiar.
KeysToEntries.ID_TRINKET_TRAINMODEL_DESC: Hand-crafted with full underbody detailing, these models offer a surprisingly intricate schematic of pre-Exodus locomotion.
KeysToEntries.ID_TRINKET_VINTAGESTEERINGWHEEL_DESC: A harmonious artifact of three-way symmetry, some Nomads believe this to be an ancient reliquary honoring the lunar, the solar and the terrestrial.
KeysToEntries.ID_TRINKET_CORRUPTEDARCPART_01_DESC: A compact, cylindrical part with multiple metallic layers. Its industrial architecture suggests a heavy-duty energy transformation function.
KeysToEntries.ID_TRINKET_CORRUPTEDARCPART_02_DESC: A metallic part with a hollow center, like a socket or port waiting for a plug, with four antenna-like prongs at its corners.
KeysToEntries.ID_TRINKET_CORRUPTEDARCPART_03_DESC: A part composed of hundreds of miniscule repeating metallic cells. It exhibits electrical integration and appears mechanically immobile.
KeysToEntries.ID_TRINKET_CORRUPTEDARCPART_04_DESC: A circular light located on the undercarriage of the glitched Wasp.
KeysToEntries.ID_TRINKET_CORRUPTEDARCPART_05_DESC: A hefty, electro-mechanical part with integrated magnetic circuitry. Perhaps used for data storage or processing.
